description: Northern Province - Notifying the Transfer Court Fines and Penalties Statute of Northern Province Provincial Council (No. 01 of 2017) Transfer of Court Fines Penalties Statute of  Northern Province - Extraordinary Gaz. No. 2021/33 of June 01, 2017 is hereby cancelled
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the enactment of a provincial statute (Transfer of Court Fines and Penalties Statute No. 01 of 2017) that establishes legal procedures for transferring court-collected fines and penalties to local authorities. It involves the creation of new legal provisions, interpretation clauses, and statutory procedures, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
